title: Dev Summit Toronto — Governing Enterprise AI Agents
description: A self-paced Obot v0.26 tutorial covering prompt injection, tool access, and data protection. Connect a vulnerable customer-support MCP server, inspect its audit trail, test tool restrictions and gateway filters, then use Obot Sentry to inventory, monitor, and control local MCP activity.
